Upmarket seafood plates, sea terrace views, and 5,122 reviews backing it up. All under $30 a head.

Xin Chao on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is the spot locals bring guests they want to impress. Fresh catch, buzzing atmosphere, and that terrace facing the water hits different at sunset.

Phu Quoc seafood at this level usually costs double. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
